targetPath: /brazil/rio-de-janeiro/rio-champions-parade-2027-sambadrome/tour/
kind: excursion_tours
status: approved
buttonLabel: "Explore tours for the 2027 Champions' Parade"
lead: >-
  The 2027 Carnival Champions' Parade will take place at Rio de Janeiro's Sambadrome on February 13. Ada Tours includes admission and transfers in a ten-day itinerary from February 12 to 21, followed by a beach stay in Angra dos Reis. Here we explain how the dates align, the late return from the parade, the itinerary inclusions, and the differences between hotel options.
---

## Tours to the 2027 Carnival Champions' Parade: dates, Sambadrome, and an ocean holiday

On **February 13, 2027**, Rio de Janeiro will host the Champions' Parade: the samba schools with the best results from the main competition return to the Sambadrome. This is a separate Carnival event following the competitive parades on February 7, 8, and 9. The date is confirmed by the calendar of LIESA, the Carnival parade organizer.

The [Ada Tours excursion to the 2027 Champions' Parade](/brazil/rio-de-janeiro/rio-champions-parade-2027-sambadrome/) includes an admission ticket and a hotel–Sambadrome–hotel transfer. How the visit fits into a particular tour matters: the late end of the show, the following day's schedule, and your hotel affect comfort just as much as your grandstand location.

## Confirmed itinerary: Rio and Angra dos Reis in ten days

[“Tropical Champions' Parade 2027: Rio and Angra dos Reis”](/brazil/tour/tropical-champions-parade-rio-angra-2027/) runs **from February 12 to 21, 2027**. It includes three nights in Rio, with the parade on the evening of Day 2, followed by six nights on the Angra dos Reis coast.

In Rio, travelers visit Sugarloaf Mountain, historic neighborhoods, and Corcovado with Christ the Redeemer. On the evening of February 13, the group goes to the Sambadrome. The show continues into the night, with a return transfer to the hotel afterwards.

After the city portion, the tour continues to Angra dos Reis. Free days and all-inclusive accommodation are planned on the coast. This format suits people who want a vivid Carnival experience followed by a relaxing stay beside the ocean.

Our selection includes {{catalog.toursCountPhrase}} featuring this excursion module. Compare itineraries by dates, number of nights, accommodation, and included transfers.

## Why the parade date determines the entire schedule

The event takes place on a fixed date: **Saturday, February 13, 2027**. The Champions' Parade and the main competitive parades are different evenings. A ticket for February 7–9 does not grant admission to the best schools' parade on February 13, and vice versa.

The current [ten-day program](/brazil/tour/tropical-champions-parade-rio-angra-2027/) schedules arrival for February 12 and the Champions' Parade for the next evening. This order leaves time for city sightseeing before the evening event. After the overnight show, factor in recovery time and a potentially late return to the hotel.

If the journey is organized solely around the parade, flights, accommodation in Rio, and departure dates must be coordinated. If you continue to the coast, allow time for the transfer to Angra dos Reis as well. It is not enough to offer the vague advice to “visit Carnival in February” without addressing these practical details.

## What Ada Tours admission and transfers include

The [canonical Sambadrome excursion](/brazil/rio-de-janeiro/rio-champions-parade-2027-sambadrome/) confirms two elements: admission to the Champions' Parade and organized transportation between the hotel and the Sambadrome in both directions.

However, the published module does not specify a particular sector, seat, extra grandstand services, or the conditions for leaving independently. A location in a particular part of the Sambadrome or special hospitality cannot therefore be guaranteed without an agreed offer.

Admission to the overnight parade differs from city excursions and other Carnival events. When choosing a tour, check the exact event name, calendar date, and category of admission ticket paid for.

## Accommodation and cost: which options to compare

The [“Rio – Angra dos Reis” tour](/brazil/tour/tropical-champions-parade-rio-angra-2027/) offers different 4-star and 5-star accommodation categories, with single, double, and triple occupancy options. Breakfast is included in Rio; in Angra dos Reis, the plan is All Inclusive at Vila Galé Angra or a comparable hotel.

When comparing prices, pay attention to occupancy type (SGL, DBL, TRP), hotel category, and services included. The lowest published price does not automatically apply to every room. International flights are paid for separately.

Consider how the schedule fits your preferences: three nights in Rio accommodate the stated sightseeing itinerary and Carnival evening, while six nights on the coast allow time to relax. Travelers who prefer to spend their whole holiday in Rio will be better served by a different format without the long beach extension.

## How the Champions' Parade differs from other Carnival events

The main competitions take place earlier and determine the final results. At the Champions' Parade, the best schools perform as finalists in the festive program. Spectators see costumes, floats, musical performances, and dance groups, but this is a separate evening requiring its own ticket.

For travelers, the difference is practical: choosing **February 13**, attending the Sambadrome at night, considering the hotel's proximity, and arranging the return journey. Booking a trip on other dates in the expectation of seeing the Champions' Parade is risky.

If Carnival dates are your particular interest, start with [event-focused trips](/interests/events-and-festivals/) and read the [specific 2027 tour inclusions](/brazil/tour/tropical-champions-parade-rio-angra-2027/). Any ticket commitments must match the published itinerary.

## Frequently asked questions about the 2027 Champions' Parade

### When will Rio's 2027 Carnival Champions' Parade take place?

On Saturday, **February 13, 2027**. This date appears in LIESA's official calendar. On the published Ada Tours itinerary, the parade is scheduled for the evening of Day 2.

### Is admission included in the ten-day tour?

Yes. The [“Rio and Angra dos Reis” tour](/brazil/tour/tropical-champions-parade-rio-angra-2027/) includes the Champions' Parade, admission, and transfers between the hotel and the Sambadrome in both directions. Confirm the exact ticket category when selecting accommodation.

### Can I return to the hotel after the show?

Yes. A return transfer is included in the [excursion module](/brazil/rio-de-janeiro/rio-champions-parade-2027-sambadrome/). The parade continues through the night, however, so plan the following day with a late return in mind.

### What is the difference between 4-star and 5-star hotels?

They differ in stated category and the prices listed for SGL, DBL, and TRP occupancy. Breakfast is specified in Rio and All Inclusive on the coast. The specific hotel may be replaced by one of comparable standard under the trip's conditions.

### Are flights to Brazil paid for separately?

International flights are not included in the [ten-day tour](/brazil/tour/tropical-champions-parade-rio-angra-2027/). Arrival and return flight times should be coordinated with the fixed dates of the Carnival event.

## Rio city tour: Corcovado, Christ the Redeemer, and Sugarloaf Mountain

Rio de Janeiro is recognizable by two iconic mountain silhouettes: Corcovado with the Christ the Redeemer statue and Sugarloaf Mountain beside Guanabara Bay. Our [“City Tour + Corcovado + Sugarloaf Mountain” excursion](/brazil/rio-de-janeiro/rio-city-corcovado-sugarloaf-tour/) combines central-city sightseeing and ascents to both famous viewpoints in **8 hours**.

The excursion costs **$80** and includes lunch, transfers, and guide services. The guide collects participants from their hotel in the morning. Check the precise price conditions and service details for your chosen booking option.

## First, the city: architecture and historic districts

On the way to Corcovado, the excursion passes through central Rio. Here you can see churches, old monasteries, and buildings from different eras alongside modern architecture. City landmarks include Candelária Church, São Bento Monastery, the Lapa Arches, the Municipal Theatre, and other sights.

This is an overview of the city, so the list of landmarks should not be read as a promise of an extensive interior tour of every building. The day's main highlights are Corcovado and Sugarloaf Mountain, while the city route provides the context for these attractions.

## Corcovado and Christ the Redeemer

The route to the statue climbs through green mountain scenery. The program includes a ride on a small train through a forested section of the slope, followed by a short walk to the statue. From the viewpoint, you can see the bay, Rio's neighborhoods, the mountains, and the coastline.

Corcovado is about more than a photograph with the statue. The mountain's height and position reveal how the city is set between forested hills and the sea. This distinctive Rio landscape features in UNESCO's World Heritage description.

## Sugarloaf Mountain and the cable car

The next stage goes to Praia Vermelha. From there, a cable car takes travelers first to Morro da Urca and then to **Sugarloaf Mountain**. The viewpoints offer a different perspective, with Guanabara Bay, the coast, and the city's terrain closer at hand.

| Viewpoint | Main attraction |
|---|---|
| Corcovado | Christ the Redeemer and city views |
| Sugarloaf Mountain | Bay, coast, and mountains |

Neither mountain is a full substitute for the other. On Corcovado, the statue is the main visual landmark; on Sugarloaf, the combination of sea and steep granite slopes defines the experience.

## What the price includes and how to plan the day

The excursion includes **lunch, transfers, and a guide**. Total duration is 8 hours. It also includes the trip to Corcovado and the cable car up Sugarloaf Mountain; confirm ticket arrangements and exact visiting times for your selected date.

Weather has a particularly strong influence on the views from the summits. Clouds may obscure the panorama even when it is sunny below. Queues can form at the trains and cable cars, so avoid overloading this eight-hour itinerary with additional visits.

Lunch is scheduled closer to the end of the excursion, after which the group returns to the hotel.

## Frequently asked questions about the Corcovado and Sugarloaf Mountain excursion

### Can both mountains be seen in one day?

Yes. Both summits are included in our eight-hour itinerary.

### Is lunch included?

Yes. The excursion includes lunch, transfers, and guide services.

### How much does the excursion cost?

The excursion costs **$80**. Take the conditions of your chosen booking option into account.

## Deep-sea fishing in Rio: a full day beyond the beaches

[Rio de Janeiro](/brazil/place/rio-de-janeiro/) has another side beyond its beaches and city attractions: the open Atlantic, where a day can revolve around sea fishing. Ada Tours' **“Deep-Sea Fishing in Rio”** excursion lasts **12 hours** and includes time aboard a vessel, waiting for a bite, handling fishing tackle, and returning to the coast.

This format means spending much of the day on the water. The movement of the boat, currents, wind, and handling fish all become part of the experience. It is intended for people genuinely interested in fishing, rather than those looking for a short sightseeing cruise along the shoreline.

**A catch is not guaranteed.** Success depends on the season, fish behavior, weather, and fishing methods. Being happy to spend a day at sea is more important than any promise concerning a particular species or fish size.

## What Ada Tours' 12-hour fishing trip includes

The excursion includes:

- **An ADVENTURE FISHING outing.**
- **Fuel for the boat.**
- **Fishing equipment.**
- **Snacks and non-alcoholic drinks:** sandwiches, water, an isotonic drink, and soft drinks.

Duration is **12 hours**. The exact boarding point, boat model, number of participants, types of tackle, and proposed fishing areas are not specified for this trip. Arrange these details for your actual departure. Do not assume trolling, catching a particular species, or traveling a certain distance offshore without a confirmed itinerary.

Alcoholic drinks are explicitly excluded. Toilet facilities, shade, and storage options for personal belongings also depend on the particular vessel.

## Price of deep-sea fishing in Rio

The price is **$1350 per person**. Discounts may be available for multiple participants, but no exact group-pricing scale is specified. For several anglers, the final amount is calculated based on the agreed group size.

Compare the price against the components of the fishing day, not merely the duration of the boat trip. It is useful to ask how many hours are actually spent fishing, what type of vessel is used, how much tackle is available, and how fuel, drinks, and cancellations due to unsafe seas are handled.

## A day on the Atlantic

A morning departure allows most daylight hours to be spent away from the bustle of the city, but **the departure time is not fixed** in our excursion terms. After boarding, the crew decides on a safe route and fishing locations according to the wind, swell, and sea conditions.

For an angler, the highlights may be preparing tackle, watching for bites, and playing a fish. Between attempts, there is time to look out over the ocean horizon and see Rio's coastline from the water. Follow strict safety rules when handling hooks, fishing line, and moving tackle: in the confined space aboard, the crew coordinates everyone's actions.

If the wind strengthens, the sea becomes rough, or another safety issue develops, the route and duration may change. The captain and local operator decide whether the outing can continue.

## Fishing licenses and recreational fishing rules in Brazil

Brazil regulates **recreational and sport fishing**, including a separate category for fishing from a boat. The Ministry of Fisheries publishes information on licenses, validity periods, registration conditions for foreign visitors, and possible additional regional rules.

The fact that the excursion includes tackle **does not by itself mean** that a personal fishing license is included in the price. Before traveling, establish what license or permit the visitor needs for the chosen format, who arranges the documents, and which restrictions apply in the waters where the trip takes place.

Regulations may address fish species, minimum catch sizes, seasonal bans, permitted methods, and handling of caught fish. Whether to release or keep a catch must always comply with local rules and the captain's instructions.

## What to bring on a deep-sea fishing trip

Suitable clothing, a cap, sunglasses, gloves, and sunscreen **are not part of the supplied services**: bring them yourself.

Windproof clothing, non-slip shoes, and remedies for seasickness can also be useful; consult a doctor about medication when necessary. Sun exposure may feel stronger at sea due to reflection from the water, and prolonged swell can cause motion sickness even in people who normally travel comfortably.

Check document requirements and health restrictions before boarding. In rough seas, if someone feels unwell, or if safety rules are not followed, the captain may change the plans.

## How fishing differs from other water activities in Rio

Unlike a [surfing lesson at Arpoador](/brazil/rio-de-janeiro/rio-de-janeiro-surfing-lesson/), where the main skill is controlling a board on a wave, deep-sea fishing occupies nearly a whole day and centers on fishing tackle at sea. It is a specialized standalone format within our [fishing trips catalog](/interests/fishing/).

If your [Brazil](/brazil/) itinerary also includes Rio's city attractions, reserve a separate day for the 12-hour fishing trip. After such a long outing, allow time to rest and avoid scheduling essential flights immediately after the expected return.

## Frequently asked questions about deep-sea fishing in Rio

### How long does the fishing trip last?

Ada Tours specifies a **12-hour duration**. The exact departure and finishing times are agreed when arranging the outing.

### How much does the excursion cost?

The public description gives a price of **$1350 per person**. A discount is possible for a group of more than one person, but no exact group rate is published.

### Are tackle and fuel included?

Yes. The published list includes fishing equipment, fuel, snacks, and non-alcoholic beverages.

### Can a large fish be guaranteed?

No. A catch depends on natural conditions and the fishing location. Promising a particular species or trophy fish without evidence would be misleading.

### Is a special license required?

Brazil has registration and licensing requirements for recreational fishing, including fishing from a vessel. Confirm the requirements for your citizenship and chosen format; the Ada Tours listing does not name a license among its inclusions.

## Hang gliding over Rio de Janeiro: Pedra Bonita and Pepino Beach

One of the most unusual ways to see [Rio de Janeiro](/brazil/place/rio-de-janeiro/) is to soar above its Atlantic coastline on a hang glider. The takeoff site on Pedra Bonita lies among the forested slopes of [Tijuca National Park](/brazil/place/tijuca-national-park/); the landing takes place beside the ocean, on Pepino Beach in São Conrado. From the air, you see green mountains, urban neighborhoods, and the curves of the coastline.

For the [Ada Tours “Hang Gliding over Rio” excursion](/brazil/rio-de-janeiro/rio-de-janeiro-hang-gliding/), we offer a **six-hour program** including transfers, a briefing, and the flight. An **English-speaking instructor** and **on-camera recording** are included. Prices start **from $390 per person**, with possible discounts for two or more participants.

## Preparation and takeoff

Following the hotel transfer, participants arrive at Pedra Bonita. This is a well-known center for free flight in Rio: the official Tijuca National Park page describes two takeoff ramps at approximately **517 m**, one for hang gliders and the other for paragliders.

Before the flight, the instructor explains the takeoff run, helps prepare equipment, and practices the required movements with the participant. Instructor and passenger then run together from the ramp into the air. For a first-time flyer, following the instructor's commands precisely matters far more than attempting independent maneuvers.

From the route you can see [Tijuca's forested slopes](/brazil/place/tijuca-national-park/), the ocean, and the São Conrado shoreline. The flight ends with a landing at Pepino Beach. The São Conrado free-flight club identifies this as a principal route for tandem flights above the city.

## How long is the actual flight?

**Six hours** is the duration of **the entire excursion**, including travel, preparation, and possible waiting for suitable conditions. It does not mean six continuous hours in the air. Actual airtime depends on wind, takeoff conditions, and the instructor's operational decision.

The departure time may shift because of the weather. If the wind or visibility is unsuitable, the flight is postponed or canceled: aviation safety takes priority over a planned time. An exact takeoff time therefore cannot be guaranteed in advance.

If you have a fixed domestic or international flight that day, avoid scheduling hang gliding too close to your airport departure. Extra time is needed mainly because of the weather and the wait for a safe takeoff window.

## Participant requirements and safe flying

Local clubs and qualified instructors organize tandem flights in the area. The national park explicitly advises beginners to use experienced, certified professionals. A first hang-gliding flight is possible only when the operator's participation requirements are met, a briefing has been completed, and weather conditions are suitable.

Age, weight, and medical restrictions depend on the operator and equipment. Confirm the exact limits in advance, especially if you have heart or spinal conditions or significant mobility limitations. On the takeoff ramp, follow instructions strictly, stay away from the edge outside permitted areas, and do not interfere with other crews.

Choose closed-toe shoes, clothing that allows free movement, and secure personal belongings. Participants must be ready to take several quick steps during takeoff and follow instructions on body position for landing. The instructor makes the final decision about whether you can fly.

## What is included and how the video is provided

The Ada Tours excursion includes **transfers**, **an English-speaking instructor**, and **a camera recording of the flight**. A **DVD copy can be ordered separately** if desired. Do not confuse the included recording with any physical format or carrier the customer might choose.

Prices start **from $390 per person**. Ask about the possible discount for two or more participants and availability for your chosen date.

| Item | Ada Tours information |
|---|---|
| Entire program | 6 hours |
| Price | From $390 per person |
| Instructor language | English |
| Video | Recording included |

Travelers who prefer to enjoy panoramic views without flying can visit ground-based viewpoints around Rio, including [Sugarloaf Mountain](/brazil/place/sugarloaf-mountain/) and [Corcovado](/brazil/place/corcovado-christ-the-redeemer/). These are different excursion formats that can be combined with your trip, but are not automatically included in the hang-gliding program.

## Frequently asked questions about hang gliding

### Does the flight last six hours?

No. **Six hours** is the duration of the entire excursion including transfers, the briefing, preparation, and flying. Airtime depends on weather conditions.

### Where does the flight start and finish?

Takeoff is at **Pedra Bonita** in the Tijuca area, and landing is on **Pepino Beach** in São Conrado. An English-speaking instructor provides a briefing before takeoff.

### How much does the excursion cost?

The published price starts **from $390 per person**. Discounts may be possible for groups of two or more; no exact amount is specified.

### Will my flight be recorded?

Camera recording is among the included services. A separate DVD can be ordered for an additional charge; delivery arrangements are agreed separately.

### What if the weather is unsuitable?

Takeoff depends on wind, visibility, and the operator's decision. For safety, the flight may be rescheduled or canceled. Discuss the conditions for changing the program before your departure date.

## Rio de Janeiro tours with hang gliding

Hang gliding lets you see Rio from above and experience the ocean, green slopes, and city beaches from a new perspective. The [hang-gliding excursion](/brazil/rio-de-janeiro/rio-de-janeiro-hang-gliding/) takes off from Pedra Bonita and lands on Pepino Beach. It differs from a conventional sightseeing trip: passengers fly in tandem with an instructor and receive a briefing before takeoff.

Our selection includes {{catalog.toursCountPhrase}} that are linked to this excursion. **Being linked to a tour does not mean the flight is included in its base price**: it may be offered as an optional experience during a stay in Rio.

## How the excursion works and how much time to allow

Our standalone excursion lasts **6 hours**. This includes transfers, takeoff preparations, assistance from an English-speaking instructor, the flight itself, and a camera recording. The price starts **from $390 per person**, with a possible discount for 2 or more participants. A DVD copy of the video is ordered separately.

| Stage | What happens |
|---|---|
| Pedra Bonita | Briefing and takeoff |
| Above the coast | Tandem flight with an instructor |
| Pepino Beach | Landing and finish |

The six hours cover the entire excursion, including journeys and preparation, not just time in the air. Weather is especially important for free flight, and the operator confirms the suitable conditions before departure.

For a trip involving several cities, it is best to plan hang gliding on a day without a compulsory morning flight or a packed sightseeing schedule. A change to the takeoff time then will not force you to shorten other paid excursions.

## Which tours can include hang gliding?

One of the itineraries linked to this excursion is the [12-day journey through Brazil, Argentina, and Chile](/multi-country/tour/brazil-argentina-chile-iguazu-12-days/). Its main stops are Rio de Janeiro, Iguazu, Buenos Aires, and Santiago de Chile. Hang gliding is offered as a separate excursion, so **confirm its place in the schedule and the additional cost before booking**.

If flying over Rio is the main purpose of your whole journey, a shorter stay in the city may be more convenient than a long multi-country trip. To compare options, open the [Brazil tour catalog](/brazil/tour/) and choose an itinerary with sufficient free time in [Rio de Janeiro](/brazil/place/rio-de-janeiro/). Rio's presence on a route alone does not mean a flight is included.

## Hang glider or helicopter: which should you choose?

A [helicopter excursion above Rio](/brazil/rio-de-janeiro/rio-de-janeiro-helicopter-flight/) provides views of the city from inside a cabin. The route and duration depend on the chosen flight option. Hang gliding takes place in the open air, with preparation at a mountain takeoff point and landing beside the ocean.

The two activities differ in participation requirements, sensitivity to weather, and the feeling of flying. If your priority is photographs of city landmarks from above, consider a helicopter. If you want to experience free flight over the coast, a tandem hang glider with an instructor is a good fit.

Do not schedule the flight back-to-back with other excursions on the same day. First confirm that passenger conditions are met, the departure time, and whether the activity can be moved if the wind is unsuitable.

## Preparing for your flight day

Wear clothing that allows easy movement at the takeoff ramp and bring closed-toe shoes. Agree on specific weight, health, age, and equipment requirements with the operator: these may depend on the aircraft and the particular pilot.

Let us know in advance if anyone in the group would prefer to remain an observer. The Pedra Bonita area also has views of the mountains and coast, but arrangements for accompanying non-fliers and waiting need to be agreed separately.

If you are considering hang gliding as an addition to cultural sightseeing, explore other [adventure trips](/interests/adventure/) and nature-focused itineraries. This can help you balance active and relaxed days throughout the journey.

## Frequently asked questions about adding hang gliding to a tour

### Is hang gliding included in the price of a Rio tour?

The excursion's appearance among a tour's related activities **does not confirm its inclusion**. Check the paid services and optional extras for the selected tour. The standalone excursion's price appears in its [description](/brazil/rio-de-janeiro/rio-de-janeiro-hang-gliding/).

### How long does the excursion take?

Ada Tours states a duration of **6 hours** for the entire activity, including transfers and preparation. This figure does not indicate airtime.

### Can the flight be recorded?

Yes. The standalone excursion includes a camera recording. A separate DVD copy is an optional paid service.

### Can I fly on the day I arrive in Rio?

Consider this only after checking your flight schedule, transfer time, weather window, and operator confirmation. A day with extra flexibility is better for a reliable itinerary.
